groups.name: repo
groups.blurb: create, list, fork, update and delete repositories

groups.name: tree
groups.blurb: list a directory of a repository at a ref

groups.name: file
groups.blurb: read one file at a ref

groups.name: event
groups.blurb: push events recorded for a repository

groups.name: events
groups.blurb: live repository state events after a sequence cursor

groups.name: snapshot
groups.blurb: snapshot metadata for a ref (and build demands)

groups.name: change
groups.blurb: change sets: open, review, update and merge

groups.name: review
groups.blurb: reviews, approvals, escalations, guides and findings

groups.name: finding
groups.blurb: review findings tied to a change head and its coverage units

groups.name: task
groups.blurb: agent tasks and their claim leases

groups.name: issue
groups.blurb: issues and their dispatch to agents

groups.name: ci
groups.blurb: CI jobs, flakes and hosted execution

operations.name: get_user
operations.description: Show the authenticated human account (login, email, admin flag). Agent tokens are refused.

operations.name: list_repos
operations.description: List the repositories owned by the authenticated user (same set as GET /api/v1/repos).

operations.name: get_repo
operations.description: Repository metadata (visibility, default branch, clone URL). Private repos you cannot read are not found.

operations.name: create_repo
operations.description: Create a repository owned by the authenticated user. Visibility defaults to private.

operations.name: update_repo
operations.description: Change a repository description or visibility. Needs the admin role on the repository.

operations.name: delete_repo
operations.description: Delete a repository with its git data, workspaces, changes and snapshots. Needs the admin role; agent tokens are refused.

operations.name: fork_repo
operations.description: Fork a repository you can read into a new private repository owned by you. Agent tokens are refused.

operations.name: import_repo
operations.description: Import an HTTPS git remote into a new repository owned by you (status importing). Agent tokens are refused.

params.name: name
params.description: Repository name (default: the last segment of the URL)

operations.name: get_tree
operations.description: List the entries (name, type, mode, hash) of a directory at a ref, like git ls-tree <ref> [<dir>].

params.name: ref
params.description: Branch, tag or commit SHA (default: the default branch)

operations.name: read_file
operations.description: Read one file at a ref. Text comes back as utf-8, anything else as base64 (encoding field).

params.name: ref
params.description: Branch, tag or commit SHA (default: the default branch)

operations.name: list_events
operations.description: Push events recorded for the repository, newest first, with the per-effect processing state.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page (nextCursor)

operations.name: list_repo_events
operations.description: Live repository state events after an event sequence cursor.

operations.name: get_path_history
operations.description: Commits on the default branch that changed a path, newest first (first-parent history, like git log --first-parent -- <path>). The index is built on demand in bounded steps; index.complete says whether the list is the whole history, and repeating the call advances an incomplete index.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page (nextCursor)

operations.name: get_snapshot
operations.description: Snapshot metadata for a ref (ready, building, absent or failed). Never starts a build.

operations.name: request_snapshot
operations.description: Demand a snapshot build for a ref; returns the metadata view plus started:true|false.

operations.name: compare
operations.description: Changed files between two commit-ishes (direct two-tree diff) with totals and a risk rating.

params.name: base
params.description: Base branch, tag, full ref or commit SHA

params.name: head
params.description: Head branch, tag, full ref or commit SHA

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page (nextCursor)

operations.name: get_file_diff
operations.description: Hunks of one changed file between two commit-ishes (git -U3 numbering).

params.name: base
params.description: Base branch, tag, full ref or commit SHA

params.name: head
params.description: Head branch, tag, full ref or commit SHA

operations.name: get_commit_diff
operations.description: Changed files of one commit against its first parent (the empty tree for a root commit).

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page (nextCursor)

operations.name: create_workspace
operations.description: Create an agent workspace: a server-side ref refs/heads/agents/<id>/<slug> at the base head, with an optional intent declaration.

params.name: task
params.description: What the workspace is for (1-500 characters)

params.name: agent
params.description: Agent display name (default: the token agent or your login)

params.name: intent
params.description: Optional intent declaration {paths: string[], prefixes?: string[], ttlSeconds?: number}

params.name: issue
params.description: Open issue the workspace resolves: the change it opens closes the issue when it merges into the default branch

operations.name: list_workspaces
operations.description: Workspaces of the repository, newest first.

params.name: status
params.description: active, merged, abandoned or all (default all)

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page (nextCursor)

operations.name: get_workspace
operations.description: One workspace with its live head.

operations.name: create_change_set
operations.description: Open the change set of a workspace (head = the workspace branch) with an explicit merge policy.

operations.name: abandon_workspace
operations.description: Abandon a workspace: closes its open change set and deletes its ref. Idempotent.

operations.name: add_dependency
operations.description: Pin a workspace to another live workspace of the same repository at its exact current revision. The dependent's change cannot merge until the pinned revision lands (an enqueued dependent waits in the train). Chains are limited to 4 workspaces and cycles are refused with the path.

params.name: revision
params.description: The source's current head commit (40 hex); refused 422 REVISION_NOT_CURRENT naming currentRevision otherwise

operations.name: list_dependencies
operations.description: A workspace's pins with their state (active, stale, broken or satisfied), reason, depth and the source's current head.

operations.name: repin_dependency
operations.description: Explicitly recover a stale or broken pin: move it to the current revision of the same source or of another live workspace. The platform never repins on its own; the dependent's ref and commits are untouched. Reports the previous pin.

params.name: revision
params.description: The source's current head commit (40 hex)

params.name: onWorkspace
params.description: Another live source workspace (default: keep the source)

operations.name: detach_dependency
operations.description: Remove a pin explicitly; the dependent then publishes without that constraint. The dependent's ref, base and change are untouched.

operations.name: create_change
operations.description: Open a change set from a head branch into a base branch.

operations.name: list_changes
operations.description: Change sets of the repository, newest number first.

params.name: state
params.description: open (default), closed, merged, conflicted or all

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page (nextCursor)

operations.name: get_change
operations.description: One change set with its risk rating, live mergeability, check runs and ordered remaining actions.

params.name: number
params.description: Change set number within the repository

operations.name: update_change
operations.description: Edit a change set title, body, merge policy or open/closed state. Setting auto merges it when mergeable.

params.name: number
params.description: Change set number within the repository

operations.name: merge_change
operations.description: Explicitly merge a change set into its base (fast-forward or a two-parent merge commit) under branch rules and required checks.

params.name: number
params.description: Change set number within the repository

params.name: attribution
params.description: Attribution note for a two-parent merge commit: {agent?, session?, promptHash?, model?}; omitted fields name the merging principal

operations.name: get_mergeability
operations.description: Whether a change set merges cleanly now, including conflicts, required checks and its ordered remaining actions.

params.name: number
params.description: Change set number within the repository

operations.name: list_checks
operations.description: Check runs of a change set, newest first.

params.name: number
params.description: Change set number within the repository

operations.name: enqueue_change
operations.description: Enqueue a change set for the integration train. Enqueue approves the change's current head; the train merges it once the exact composed tree passes required checks. Drafts are refused (409); a full queue answers 429 with Retry-After.

params.name: number
params.description: Change set number within the repository

params.name: headSha
params.description: Expected head commit (40 hex); refused 409 HEAD_MOVED if the change has moved

params.name: mergePolicy
params.description: Expected merge policy; refused 409 POLICY_CHANGED if it differs

params.name: attribution
params.description: Attribution note for a two-parent merge commit: {agent?, session?, promptHash?, model?}; omitted fields name the enqueuing principal

operations.name: dequeue_change
operations.description: Take a change set out of the merge queue (not while it is being published). The change itself stays open.

params.name: number
params.description: Change set number within the repository

operations.name: get_queue
operations.description: Active merge-queue entries in train order per target branch: position, state, approved head, exact composition identity and reason.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page (nextCursor)

operations.name: get_train
operations.description: Integration train status: active entries per target branch with their pins and, for an entry held back by an unresolved pin, a machine-readable waiting reason {code, message, dependencies}.

operations.name: get_reviews
operations.description: The review packet of a change: required and counted approvals of the current head, reviews with principal, model family and differentFamily, blockers and escalations.

params.name: number
params.description: Change set number within the repository

operations.name: review_change
operations.description: Review the change's current head as a human or agent principal other than the author. An approval may also enable auto-merge when all gates pass; a request-changes, or an approval next to one, escalates to a human.

params.name: number
params.description: Change set number within the repository

params.name: headSha
params.description: The reviewed head commit (40 hex); refused 409 HEAD_MOVED if the change has moved

params.name: ship
params.description: Set merge policy to auto with this approval

operations.name: approve_change
operations.description: Approve the change's current head. Set ship to enable auto-merge when all gates pass. The approval is bound to that exact head.

params.name: number
params.description: Change set number within the repository

params.name: headSha
params.description: The reviewed head commit (40 hex); refused 409 HEAD_MOVED if the change has moved

params.name: ship
params.description: Set merge policy to auto with this approval

operations.name: request_changes
operations.description: Request changes on the change's current head. Publication is blocked and escalated to a human until one approves or resolves it.

params.name: number
params.description: Change set number within the repository

params.name: headSha
params.description: The reviewed head commit (40 hex); refused 409 HEAD_MOVED if the change has moved

operations.name: list_pending_reviews
operations.description: Live changes still short of approvals or with an open escalation, including current-head checks readiness; optionally filter ready or not-ready changes.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page (nextCursor)

params.name: ready
params.description: Filter readiness: true for ready changes, false for not ready

operations.name: assign_reviewer
operations.description: Pick a reviewer among the agents holding a live write token for the repository (or the given ones), preferring a different model family than the author; reports whether the preference was met.

params.name: number
params.description: Change set number within the repository

operations.name: request_review
operations.description: Persist a request for a human or agent with current write access to review an open change.

params.name: number
params.description: Change set number within the repository

operations.name: withdraw_review_request
operations.description: Withdraw a persisted reviewer request from an open change.

params.name: number
params.description: Change set number within the repository

operations.name: resolve_escalation
operations.description: Resolve an open escalation as a human with a required note recorded as the reason (agents are refused 403 HUMAN_REQUIRED). Approving the current head as a human independent of the author (not the human who minted an authoring agent) resolves every open escalation too.

params.name: number
params.description: Change set number within the repository

params.name: note
params.description: Required note recorded with the resolution

operations.name: get_review_policy
operations.description: The repository review policy: approving reviews required per change from distinct principals other than the author.

operations.name: set_review_policy
operations.description: Set how many approving reviews of the current head (humans or agents, distinct, not the author) a change needs (repo admins only).

params.name: guideRequired
params.description: Require a guide for the current head

params.name: dangerAckRequired
params.description: Require acknowledgements for scrutinize coverage before approval

params.name: nudgeAfterMinutes
params.description: Delay before review reminders (15-10080 minutes); null disables reminders

operations.name: get_review_analytics
operations.description: Finding outcomes grouped by filer model family and its evidence level (known agent families are declared), plus review timing and guide-coverage medians for recent changes.

params.name: days
params.description: Window of change updates to include (1-180 days; default 30)

operations.name: get_review_guide
operations.description: Get deterministic change coverage, the guide and acknowledgements; include hunks only when requested.

params.name: number
params.description: Change set number within the repository

params.name: since
params.description: Only include units added since this commit SHA, or use parent for the focused diff

params.name: unacked
params.description: Only return units not acknowledged by you

operations.name: get_review_impact
operations.description: Show changed-file consumers, test consumers and import evidence for this change.

params.name: number
params.description: Change set number within the repository

operations.name: submit_review_guide
operations.description: Submit or replace a guide validated against the current coverage map.

params.name: number
params.description: Change set number within the repository

operations.name: ack_review_units
operations.description: Acknowledge or unacknowledge up to 500 coverage keys or one guide chapter.

params.name: number
params.description: Change set number within the repository

params.name: unack
params.description: Remove acknowledgements instead of adding them

operations.name: submit_findings
operations.description: Submit up to 50 findings tied to the current head and coverage units.

params.name: number
params.description: Change set number within the repository

params.name: findings
params.description: Findings with path, line, category, severity, confidence and title

operations.name: list_findings
operations.description: List findings for a change, with outdated and blocking state.

params.name: number
params.description: Change set number within the repository

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page (nextCursor)

operations.name: update_finding
operations.description: Resolve, reopen, dismiss or mark a finding as wont-fix.

params.name: number
params.description: Change set number within the repository

operations.name: list_tasks
operations.description: Agent tasks of a repository, newest first: resolve-conflict tasks name the conflicted change, its head and base commits and the conflicting paths (lockfiles marked needsRegeneration); fix-issue tasks name the issue to fix.

params.name: kind
params.description: Only tasks of this kind, e.g. resolve-conflict

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page (nextCursor)

operations.name: get_task
operations.description: One agent task with its claim lease (holder, generation, expiry), claim workspace and resolution.

operations.name: claim_task
operations.description: Claim an open task under an expiring lease. Creates (or on a reclaim reuses) a workspace: for resolve-conflict at the conflicting change's head (push the resolution there), for fix-issue at the default branch, linked to the issue. A live claim by another agent is refused 409 CLAIMED; a lapsed lease is taken over under the next generation.

params.name: agent
params.description: Agent display name (default: the token agent or your login; an agent token always claims as its agent)

operations.name: heartbeat_task
operations.description: Extend the claim lease of a task you hold. Refused 409 STALE_GENERATION when the claim was taken over.

params.name: agent
params.description: Agent display name used when claiming

params.name: ttlSeconds
params.description: New lease length in seconds (default 600, max 3600)

operations.name: complete_task
operations.description: Complete a claimed task. resolve-conflict: the workspace head must descend from the change's head and merge with the base without conflicts; the change moves to the resolution, reopens and follows its merge policy (auto merges, review waits, draft stays draft). fix-issue: the claim workspace must have opened a change (create_change_set); that change closes the issue when it merges.

params.name: sha
params.description: Expected resolution commit (40 hex); refused 409 if the workspace head differs

params.name: agent
params.description: Agent display name used when claiming

params.name: attribution
params.description: Attribution note for the resolution commit: {agent?, session?, promptHash?, model?}

operations.name: get_intent
operations.description: A workspace intent: declared paths, observed paths from pushes and what lies outside the declaration.

operations.name: set_intent
operations.description: Replace a workspace intent declaration (advisory; nothing is locked).

params.name: paths
params.description: Declared paths; a trailing / marks a directory prefix

operations.name: forecast
operations.description: Advisory forecast: active workspaces whose declared or observed paths intersect the given paths, plus semantic dependency matches (imports, export changes, contract families).

params.name: paths
params.description: Paths to forecast (at most 20; a trailing / marks a prefix)

params.name: base
params.description: Only workspaces on this base branch

params.name: exclude
params.description: Workspace id to leave out (usually your own); its own import edges are also matched semantically

params.name: semantic
params.description: Include the advisory semantic dependency layer on the first page (default true)

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page (nextCursor)

operations.name: get_overlap
operations.description: Pairs of active workspaces whose pushed changes touch the same paths, plus semantic dependency pairs (advisory, from the Nexus index).

params.name: semantic
params.description: Include advisory semantic dependency pairs on the first page (default true)

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page (nextCursor)

operations.name: list_candidates
operations.description: Compare 1-8 workspaces against a base: per-candidate summaries, pairwise diffs, overlap and a deterministic ranking.

operations.name: compose_candidates
operations.description: Compose selected workspace pieces onto the base into a new workspace and change set (refused on textual conflicts).

params.name: workspaces
params.description: Workspace ids or {workspace, paths?} objects (2-8), in fold order

params.name: title
params.description: Title of the composed change set

params.name: agent
params.description: Agent display name for the composed workspace

operations.name: list_compositions
operations.description: Compositions of the repository, newest first.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page (nextCursor)

operations.name: get_composition
operations.description: One composition: sources, composed tree and commit, its workspace and change set, and the checks answer.

operations.name: create_arena
operations.description: Create 2-8 sibling candidate workspaces from one brief at the base head. Nothing is spawned or selected automatically.

params.name: agent
params.description: Agent display name for the workspaces

operations.name: list_arenas
operations.description: Arenas of the repository, newest first.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page (nextCursor)

operations.name: get_arena
operations.description: One arena with its candidate workspaces and recorded selection.

operations.name: rank_arena
operations.description: Ranked candidates of an arena (same factors as list_candidates) plus the separate duplication report.

operations.name: select_arena_winner
operations.description: Record the chosen arena candidate. Merges, closes and abandons nothing; the winner merges through its own change set.

operations.name: create_org
operations.description: Create an organization; the caller becomes its owner.

operations.name: get_org
operations.description: An organization and your role in it.

operations.name: list_my_orgs
operations.description: Organizations the authenticated user belongs to, with roles.

operations.name: list_org_members
operations.description: Members of an organization (members only).

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page (nextCursor)

operations.name: set_org_member
operations.description: Add a member or change a role (org owners only). The last owner cannot be demoted.

operations.name: remove_org_member
operations.description: Remove a member (org owners only); also deletes the user's grants on the org's repositories.

operations.name: list_org_repos
operations.description: Repositories of an organization visible to you.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page (nextCursor)

operations.name: create_org_repo
operations.description: Create a repository owned by an organization (owners and maintainers).

operations.name: list_grants
operations.description: Explicit repository grants (repo admins only).

operations.name: set_grant
operations.description: Grant a user read, write or admin on a repository (repo admins only).

operations.name: revoke_grant
operations.description: Revoke a user's explicit grant on a repository (repo admins only).

operations.name: create_agent
operations.description: Create an agent principal owned by you or by an organization you own.

params.name: owner
params.description: Your login or an org login (default: you)

params.name: modelFamily
params.description: Model family of the agent (e.g. claude, gpt); reviewer assignment prefers a different family than the author

operations.name: list_agents
operations.description: Agents of an account you manage, sorted by name (revoked included).

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page (nextCursor)

operations.name: get_agent
operations.description: One agent you manage (status, owner, creator).

operations.name: revoke_agent
operations.description: Revoke an agent; all of its tokens stop working immediately.

operations.name: create_agent_token
operations.description: Mint an expiring agent token for one repository (read, or write with ref patterns). The token is shown once.

params.name: refs
params.description: Ref patterns a write token may update (1-16, e.g. refs/heads/agents/*)

operations.name: list_agent_tokens
operations.description: Token metadata of an agent (prefix only, never the token).

operations.name: revoke_agent_token
operations.description: Revoke one agent token.

operations.name: set_attribution
operations.description: Attach the attribution note {agent, session, promptHash, model?, actor, at} to a commit on refs/notes/kvarm-attribution (replaces an earlier note).

params.name: promptHash
params.description: Hash of the prompt that produced the commit

params.name: evidence
params.description: Signed execution evidence {keyId, runId, signature} from a trusted execution service; verified on write

operations.name: get_attribution
operations.description: A commit's attribution note (agent, session, promptHash, model, actor, at) with its evidence level (declared, authenticated or verified); not found when it has none.

operations.name: record_decision
operations.description: Record which candidate was chosen for a task and/or paths, the rejected candidates and why, for later agents to read with get_context.

params.name: task
params.description: Task id the decision belongs to (task and/or paths)

params.name: paths
params.description: Repository paths the decision covers (at most 100)

params.name: chosen
params.description: Chosen candidate, workspace or change id

params.name: rejected
params.description: Rejected candidates: ids or {id, reason} objects (at most 50)

operations.name: get_context
operations.description: Prior decisions for a task and/or paths, newest first: chosen and rejected candidates with their reasons. Bounded pages with truncated/nextCursor.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page (nextCursor)

operations.name: create_issue
operations.description: File an issue, e.g. a bug found outside the current task. With a fingerprint, a repeat report while an issue with that fingerprint is open counts one more occurrence on it (200, created false) instead of filing a duplicate (201).

params.name: body
params.description: Description: what happens, how to reproduce it

params.name: paths
params.description: Repository paths the issue is about (at most 100)

params.name: fingerprint
params.description: Stable identity of the problem (e.g. a failing test id) used to deduplicate reports

operations.name: list_issues
operations.description: Issues of the repository, newest first, filtered by state (default open) and by source (human, agent, ci, flake, guard).

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page (nextCursor)

operations.name: get_issue
operations.description: One issue with its occurrences, evidence, how it was closed, its links to changes and workspaces, and its newest comments.

operations.name: update_issue
operations.description: Edit an issue, close it (closedReason completed, not_planned or duplicate) or reopen it.

params.name: paths
params.description: Repository paths the issue is about (replaces the list)

params.name: closedReason
params.description: Why it is closed (with state closed)

operations.name: dispatch_issue
operations.description: Hand an open issue to agents as a fix-issue task (one live task per issue; 201 created, 200 the live one). An agent claims it with claim_task, gets a workspace at the default branch that declares the issue's paths as its intent, opens a change from it (create_change_set) and completes the task; the change closes the issue when it merges.

operations.name: comment_issue
operations.description: Comment on an issue (people and agents alike, closed issues included); get_issue returns the newest 50 comments.

operations.name: list_change_issues
operations.description: Issues linked to a change: closing keywords in its title or body (confirmed), an issue number in its branch name (proposed), its workspace's issue, and manual links; willClose tells which close when it merges into the default branch.

params.name: number
params.description: Change set number within the repository

operations.name: link_issue
operations.description: Confirm or reject a link between a change and an issue, e.g. accept a proposed link from the branch name. A confirmed closes link closes the issue when the change merges into the default branch; a manual decision is never recomputed away.

params.name: number
params.description: Change set number within the repository

operations.name: get_audit
operations.description: Audit export (repo admins): one record per commit with agent, session, promptHash, model, evidence level, token prefix, pushes and merges, in first-recorded order. Bounded pages with nextCursor.

params.name: format
params.description: json (default) or ndjson: one record per line, then a {page} line

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page (nextCursor)

operations.name: list_provenance_keys
operations.description: Trusted execution-service public keys for verified attribution: the repository keys and the instance keys (repo admins).

operations.name: add_provenance_key
operations.description: Trust an execution service: add its raw Ed25519 public key (base64url); its id is the key fingerprint (repo admins).

operations.name: revoke_provenance_key
operations.description: Stop trusting a provenance key for new attribution writes; levels already recorded stay as they were (repo admins).

operations.name: list_branch_rules
operations.description: Branch protection rules of the repository.

operations.name: create_branch_rule
operations.description: Protect matching refs from direct pushes and set required checks/approvals and guard completeness (repo admins only).

params.name: pattern
params.description: Branch name or ref pattern (main, release/*, refs/tags/*)

params.name: guardCompleteness
params.description: advisory (default): an incomplete kvarm/guard scan is reported only; required: it blocks publication (GUARD_INCOMPLETE)

params.name: agentApprovals
params.description: never (default): agent approvals do not satisfy protected-branch approval requirements; low-risk: different-family agents may approve heads without scrutinize files

operations.name: get_branch_rule
operations.description: One branch rule with its required checks and approvals.

operations.name: update_branch_rule
operations.description: Change a branch rule's required checks, approvals or guard completeness (the pattern is immutable).

params.name: guardCompleteness
params.description: advisory (default): an incomplete kvarm/guard scan is reported only; required: it blocks publication (GUARD_INCOMPLETE)

params.name: agentApprovals
params.description: never (default): agent approvals do not satisfy protected-branch approval requirements; low-risk: different-family agents may approve heads without scrutinize files

operations.name: delete_branch_rule
operations.description: Delete a branch rule (repo admins only).

operations.name: get_branch_policy
operations.description: The effective policy for one ref: protected, direct push, required checks, approvals and guard completeness.

operations.name: list_environments
operations.description: List reusable Linux build environments for a repository.

operations.name: create_environment
operations.description: Create a Linux build environment; requires repository admin and queues its initial build.

params.name: baseRef
params.description: Base branch (defaults to the repository default)

operations.name: rebuild_environment
operations.description: Request a new environment build without changing its configuration (repository admin only).

operations.name: start_sandbox
operations.description: Resume the caller principal’s running or sleeping sandbox for this environment, or start one. Set fresh=true to force a separate sandbox.

params.name: workspace
params.description: Workspace id to reuse or resume

operations.name: list_sandboxes
operations.description: List repository sandboxes, including sleeping snapshots.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page (nextCursor)

operations.name: list_my_sandboxes
operations.description: List human-owned sandboxes across the owner’s agents; agent credentials see only their own repository and agent.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page (nextCursor)

operations.name: exec_sandbox
operations.description: Run an audited command in the caller-owned sandbox; deny rules precede single-use human approval.

operations.name: stop_sandbox
operations.description: Sleep the caller-owned sandbox by default; discard=true destroys its resumable snapshot.

operations.name: list_ci_jobs
operations.description: The repository CI job queue, newest first: queued, running and finished runner jobs with claims, leases and the change they belong to.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page (nextCursor)

operations.name: list_ci_flakes
operations.description: Flaky-check registry: required runner checks that failed once and passed on the automatic retry, plus the checks currently quarantined for the repository.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page (nextCursor)

operations.name: quarantine_ci_check
operations.description: Quarantine a check name (repo admins only). The check still runs but its runs never satisfy or block a required-checks gate, and its failures never retry.

operations.name: restore_ci_check
operations.description: Restore a quarantined check name to normal handling (repo admins only); its recorded runs count again.

operations.name: get_ci_hosted
operations.description: Hosted CI status: the enabled flag, claimable and running jobs, the live drain state and the last drain report of the platform container runner.

operations.name: enable_ci_hosted
operations.description: Enable hosted CI execution for the repository (repo admins only): the platform container runner drains queued jobs, starting with any backlog; the user-owned runner keeps racing on the same queue.

operations.name: disable_ci_hosted
operations.description: Disable hosted CI execution for the repository (repo admins only). Queued jobs stay claimable by user-owned runners.

operations.name: list_webhooks
operations.description: Outbound webhooks of the repository with their subscribed events, state and failure count (never the secret).

operations.name: create_webhook
operations.description: Create an outbound webhook (https only, no private or internal hosts). The signing secret is in this reply only; deliveries are signed CloudEvents.

params.name: url
params.description: https URL that receives the events

params.name: events
params.description: Event types to deliver, e.g. kvarm.change.merged, kvarm.check_run.completed (list_webhooks returns the accepted set as eventTypes)

operations.name: get_webhook
operations.description: One webhook: URL, events, active, consecutive failures, last delivery and status.

operations.name: update_webhook
operations.description: Change a webhook's URL or events, or disable/re-enable it (re-enabling clears the failure count).

params.name: active
params.description: false disables the webhook; true re-enables it

operations.name: delete_webhook
operations.description: Delete a webhook; its pending deliveries are cancelled.

operations.name: rotate_webhook_secret
operations.description: Replace the signing secret of a webhook; the new secret is in this reply only.

operations.name: ping_webhook
operations.description: Send a signed kvarm.webhook.ping to one webhook through the delivery queue; returns the pending delivery.

operations.name: list_webhook_deliveries
operations.description: Delivery log of a webhook, newest first: state, attempts, response status, latency, error and a truncated response.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page (nextCursor)

operations.name: create_revert
operations.description: Revert a commit or a merged change set: builds the revert commit (git revert; merges relative to their first parent) on a kvarm-revert/ branch and opens a change set of kind revert (draft by default) that runs guard, CI and the merge queue like any change. 404 unknown commit; 409 REVERT_CONFLICT with the conflicting paths, nothing written.

params.name: sha
params.description: Commit to revert (40 hex); or pass changeNumber

params.name: changeNumber
params.description: Merged change set to revert, relative to the target it landed on; or pass sha

params.name: reason
params.description: Why: added to the revert commit message and the change body

params.name: base
params.description: Branch the revert applies to (default: the reverted change set base, else the default branch)

operations.name: get_incident_webhook
operations.description: Incident webhook status for the repository (repo admins): whether a secret exists, its generation and fingerprint, and the signature headers. The secret itself is never shown again.

operations.name: rotate_incident_secret
operations.description: Create or rotate the incident webhook secret (repo admins). The reply shows the new secret once; the previous secret stops verifying immediately. Deliveries sign "<x-kvarm-timestamp>.<raw body>" with HMAC-SHA256.

operations.name: delete_incident_webhook
operations.description: Remove the incident webhook secret (repo admins); every later delivery is refused with 401.
